versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

amazon-main-image-motion 0.1.2

- Updated project documentation in SKILL.md for clearer motion/video ratio rules and planning details.
- Clarified that output aspect ratio follows model card, and will be communicated if re-framing is necessary.
- Improved shot plan explanation: background white, product color, and label text are locked; crop is not.
- Removed obsolete or redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Minor script and docs maintenance for consistency with updated workflow and execution logic.

amazon-main-image-motion v0.1.1

- Initial release: create a short video clip from a single approved Amazon main image with subtle product motion (turntable, light sweep, or push-in).
- Ensures white background, crop, framing, and visible on-pack text are preserved pixel-identically in generated video.
- Outputs a shot plan for seller review before any billable action.
- Routes other product video or image requests to specific adjacent skills; strictly one image per clip, no stitching or recomposing.
- Handles credit checks, billing clarity, and explicit task confirmation through a bundled MCP client only (no external REST/OpenAPI).
